summary: The comment argues that conditioning E‑Rate funding on screen‑time restrictions would force schools to choose between funding and technology use, harming instructional and virtual learning, especially for rural and health‑impacted students.

claims.requested_action: Conditioning E‑Rate funding on screen‑time restrictions
claims.argument: Mandating screen‑time limits would force schools to cut technology‑based instruction or forfeit E‑Rate funds, undermining student learning.
